description: List a folder in the workspace, with the expansion state the workspace remembers. The walk, the noise-folder excludes and the jail are the shell worker's.

collapse.description: Root-relative folders to collapse. Collapsing takes its descendants with it.

expand.description: Root-relative folders to mark expanded before listing. Expansion is part of the shared workspace, so it survives a reload and both surfaces agree on it.

max_depth.description: Levels to descend. Defaults to 4 — deep enough to navigate, shallow enough that one call does not walk a whole monorepo.

path.description: Folder to list, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to the root.

expanded.description: Folders the workspace has expanded, root-relative.

path.description: Canonical absolute path of the listed folder, as shell resolved it.

tree.description: The listing exactly as the shell worker returned it (nested `{name, kind, size, mtime, children}` nodes). Passed through rather than re-modelled so this worker does not pin shell's response shape.
